results.description:
He pulled her from the water. Now he'll do anything to keep her alive.

A Navy SEAL with nothing left to fight for.

A woman with no memory of what happened and a bounty on her head.

When Ryker "Tank" Granger pulls Dahlia Swanson from a sinking car, he thinks it's a one-time rescue. But when it becomes clear that someone put her in that water, he realizes he couldn't have been more wrong.

Dahlia has dedicated her life to helping others. Now she's being hunted, with no answers and nowhere safe to turn.

Except him.

Now under Ryker's protection, Dahlia quickly learns he isn't a man who walks away.

And the closer they get, the more this stops being a mission.

It becomes personal.

Because Dahlia isn't just another life to save anymore—she's his.

And anyone who comes for her will have to go through him first.

A gripping Christian romantic suspense featuring a protective hero and the woman who gave him something to fight for.
